'''Infinity Esports Costa Rica''' is the Costa Rican team of [[INFINITY|Infinity Esports]]. It was one of eight teams selected to participate in the first season of the [[Liga Tica de Leyendas/2019 Season/Opening Season|Liga Tica de Leyendas]].
